definitions.explanation: Introduces a contrasting or qualifying statement.

examples.japanese: この{水|みず}はただです。
ただ{見|み}ているだけです。
{行|い}きたい。ただ、{時間|じかん}がない。
examples.english: I want to go. But I don't have time.

notes:
ただ has multiple meanings depending on context.

MEANINGS:
1. Free: ただで{もらう|もらう} (get for free)
2. Just/only: ただの{友達|ともだち} (just a friend)
3. But/however: ただ、～ (but ~)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ただで (for free)
- ただの + noun (just a ~, mere ~)
- ただし (however - formal)
- ただ～だけ (just ~ only)

KANJI NOTE:
Can be written as {只|ただ} but hiragana is more common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無料|むりょう}: free of charge (formal)
- だけ: only (particle)
- しかし: but, however (more formal)
